svg.aria-label: High level architecture of job-radar's data side. Sources: job boards and APIs, company career pages, Gmail job alerts, the ECB's euro rates, settings.yaml and seed lists. A PostgreSQL 17 warehouse: raw schema (2 tables, postings as received), core schema (14 tables, one row per job, skills, pay and places), mart schema (4 views). Consumers: the daily emails, the Streamlit tracker and the website on Neon. Apache Airflow runs it daily at 12pm Cairo with 14 extract tasks.
svg.title: job-radar high level architecture

g.text: DAG job_radar, daily at 12pm Cairo: schema, then 14 extract tasks (one per source group) load raw, then transform, describe and match_skills build core; the mart views are recreated by schema.
Two email DAGs send the daily emails after each collect; job_radar_backup dumps the raw and core schemas at 3am.
